name: Odysseo Core
author: Chandrabhan Shekhawat

sections.description:
Odysseo Core gives a WordPress site everything a travel business needs to publish
its offering — the content types, the search-engine markup, and the enquiry
handling — without touching a line of code.

It is the companion plugin for the free Odysseo travel theme. The theme draws
the pages; this plugin owns the data and the SEO. They are built to work together,
but your content belongs to the plugin, so it stays with you even if you change
themes later.

Who is this for?

Any site that needs to publish places, trips or vehicles:

  • Travel agencies and holiday planners
  • Tour operators — day tours, multi-day trips, guided packages
  • Car rental, taxi and chauffeur services — publishing a vehicle fleet
  • Safari, trekking and adventure companies
  • Destination management companies (DMCs) and local guides
  • Transfer and shuttle services with a fixed fleet and routes

If you are running a blog, a shop or a portfolio, you do not need this plugin.

What you get

Five travel content types — added to your WordPress admin, ready to fill in:

  • Destinations — places you cover, with a States/Regions taxonomy, tagline,
    best time to visit, ideal duration, how to reach, attractions and a gallery
  • Tour Packages — day-by-day itinerary, pricing, inclusions and exclusions
  • Fleet — vehicles with seats, luggage, features and rates
  • Testimonials — customer reviews with a star rating
  • Gallery — photo gallery with categories

Automatic SEO — nothing to configure

The moment the plugin is active it starts producing correct markup for every page:

  • Meta title and description, with a per-post override box
  • Open Graph and Twitter tags, so links look right when shared
  • Canonical URLs and robots directives
  • An XML sitemap
  • JSON-LD structured data built from your real fields — Organization /
    TravelAgency, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, TouristDestination,
    Product + Offer, TouristTrip, Vehicle, FAQPage, Service / OfferCatalog and
    AggregateRating — each one switchable on or off

Values are only published when the data actually exists. Nothing is invented — no
fake ratings and no made-up prices.

Optional AI assist

A “Generate with AI” button on the SEO box drafts an SEO title and meta
description from the post you are editing. It is off until you add your own API
key, it only runs when you click it, and it is never required — you can write
everything by hand. See “External services” below.

Contact inquiries

The theme’s contact form is handled here: submissions are stored on your own site
under Inquiries (so nothing is lost if an email bounces) and emailed to your
configured address. A honeypot field blocks the usual spam bots.

One-click demo import

Install the free “One Click Demo Import” plugin and you can reproduce the full
demo site — destinations, packages, fleet, gallery, testimonials, pages, menu and
photos — in one click, then edit it into your own.

How it works

  1. Install the Odysseo theme, then this plugin. The theme prompts you.
  2. The admin menus appear — Destinations, Tour Packages, Fleet, Testimonials,
    Gallery and Inquiries. Nothing else changes; no pages are created and no
    settings are touched without your say-so.
  3. Add your content — or run the demo import and replace the examples.
  4. The theme displays it on designed archive and single pages.
  5. SEO happens on its own. Optionally open Settings → Odysseo SEO to fine
    tune the schema types, add a Search Console token, or enable the AI assist.

Does it work without the Odysseo theme?

Yes, safely. The post types, meta boxes, SEO output and inquiries all keep working
under any theme, and your content is never locked in. What another theme will not
have is Odysseo’s designed layouts, so destinations and packages will fall back to
that theme’s normal post template. For the full design, use the Odysseo theme.

Privacy

This plugin adds no tracking, no analytics and no telemetry, and sends nothing to
the author. Contact-form submissions stay on your own site and go only to the
address you configure. The optional “Generate with AI” assist is the only feature
that contacts an outside service, and only when you click it.

External services

This plugin includes an optional “Generate with AI” button on the SEO meta box that
drafts an SEO title and meta description for a post. It is off by default, requires
you to choose a provider and enter your own API key, and only runs when you click
the button. When clicked, the post’s title and content are sent to the AI provider
you configured, using your own key, and the suggested text is returned. Nothing is
sent unless you click the button, and nothing is sent to the plugin/theme author.

You choose one of the following providers and supply your own API key:

  • OpenAI — requests are sent to api.openai.com only if you select OpenAI and enter
    an OpenAI API key.
    Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
    Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

  • Google Gemini — requests are sent to generativelanguage.googleapis.com only if
    you select Google and enter a Google AI (Gemini) API key.
    Terms of Use: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
    Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Bundled demo media

The demo importer bundles a small set of photographs in demo/images/. They are
provided under the Unsplash License, which permits free commercial use,
modification and redistribution and is GPL-compatible. They are sample content —
replace them with your own media for a live site.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Odysseo theme (Appearance → Themes → Add New).
  2. Install and activate Odysseo Core — the theme prompts you automatically on
    activation, or search for it under Plugins → Add New.
  3. Open Appearance → Getting Started and follow the checklist.
  4. Add your Destinations, Tour Packages and Fleet — or install the free “One Click
    Demo Import” plugin and import the demo, then edit it into your own.
  5. Optional: open Settings → Odysseo SEO to review the structured-data
    toggles, add a Search Console token, or set up the AI assist.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Odysseo theme?

For the full design, yes — the theme provides the layouts. The plugin still works
under any theme, and your content is never trapped: it stays in WordPress if you
switch themes.

Do I have to configure anything for SEO?

No. Meta tags, Open Graph, canonical URLs, the sitemap and JSON-LD all start
working as soon as the plugin is active. The settings page is only for fine-tuning.

Is the AI feature required? Does it cost money?

It is entirely optional and off by default. You add your own API key from OpenAI or
Google, and that provider bills you directly for what you use. The plugin never
charges anything, and every SEO field can be written by hand instead.

Does this conflict with Yoast, Rank Math or another SEO plugin?

No. If a major SEO plugin is active, Odysseo Core steps back and stops emitting its
own meta and schema, so you never get duplicated output.

Where do contact form submissions go?

They are saved on your own site under Inquiries and emailed to the address set
in the Customizer (or your admin email). Because WordPress sends mail via PHP
mail(), which many hosts deliver unreliably, we recommend a free SMTP plugin such
as WP Mail SMTP for dependable delivery.

Will it create pages or change my settings when I activate it?

No. Activating adds the admin menus and nothing else — no pages, no front-page
changes. Pages are only created if you deliberately run the demo import.

What happens to my content if I deactivate the plugin?

Nothing is deleted. Your destinations, packages, fleet and inquiries stay in the
database; they simply stop being displayed until you activate the plugin again.

How do I check my structured data is working?

Paste any page URL into Google’s Rich Results Test. There is a link to it on the
Settings → Odysseo SEO screen.
